==Features==
A parser of a subset of Lojban. Output is in AtomSpace format.

== How to install ==
# docker pull opencog/opencog-dev:cli
# docker run -it opencog/opencog-dev:cli
# git clone https://github.com/opencog/opencog
# cd opencog/opencog/nlp/lojban/HaskellLib
# sudo ldconfig /usr/local/lib/opencog/
# stack build
# <tt>./run.sh</tt> for interactive mode or <tt>./run.sh t</tt> for testmode
